description.zh: 驱动通道名称。支持中文、英文大小写字母、数字和下划线（_），长度限制1~30个字符。
description.en: The name of the driver channel. The name can contain Chinese characters, English letters (both uppercase and lowercase), digits, and underscores (_). It must be 1 to 30 characters in length.

description.zh:
配置内容。

- **Configs.N.Format**参数的值为KV或JSON时，此处请填写配置内容。配置内容格式，请参见[驱动通道配置说明](~~172321~~)。

- **Configs.N.Format**参数的值为FILE时，此处请填写阿里云对象存储OSS地址。OSS地址请调用[CreateOssPreSignedAddress](~~155858~~)接口获取。
description.en:
Configuration content.

- When the value of the **Configs.N.Format** parameter is KV or JSON, specify the configuration content here. For the configuration content format, see [Driver Channel Configuration Description](~~172321~~).

- When the value of the **Configs.N.Format** parameter is FILE, specify an Alibaba Cloud Object Storage Service (OSS) address here. To obtain an OSS address, invoke the [CreateOssPreSignedAddress](~~155858~~) API.

description.zh: 配置格式。取值有KV（键值对配置）、JSON（JSON格式）、FILE（配置文件）。
description.en: The configuration format. Valid values include KV (key-value pair configuration), JSON (JSON format), and FILE (configuration file).

description.zh: 配置的关键字。在有多个配置的情况下，用于区分配置。
description.en: The keyword of the configuration. It is used to distinguish between multiple configurations.

description.zh:
驱动ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**驱动管理**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标驱动名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~)接口获取。
description.en:
The driver ID. You can obtain the ID by moving the mouse pointer over the target driver name on the **Driver Management** page in the [Edge Computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list).

You can also call the [QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~) API to obtain the ID.

description.zh:
边缘实例的ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**边缘实例**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~)接口获取。
description.en:
The ID of the edge instance. You can obtain the ID by moving the mouse pointer over the target edge instance name on the **Edge Instances** page in the [Edge Computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list).

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) API to obtain the ID.

description.zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
description.en: The instance ID. Do not specify this parameter for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为20。

> RAM用户共享主账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Condition
Each Alibaba Cloud account can send a maximum of 20 queries per second (QPS) to call this API.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot create-edge-instance-channel --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --instance-id 6GaTtvTj7vJhiS000000 --driver-id 9c1ae7bd59f1469abbdccc9592000000 --channel-name le_name0 --configs Format=JSON Content=protocol_:_TCP_,_ip_:_1.2.3.4_,_port_:1 Key=key1 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
